notes.title: Silent Dream 1.60ver Update Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40608533/a76acf746bb94036c410f7dfff85b597d65f357e.png[/img]
Previous Updates
1.45ver
1. "Shadow of disaster"Balance Adjustment
※n version 1.40 the"Shadow of disaster"Chase through the wall but pursuit speed of a nomad is the same players and have difficulty in what has been modified.
☆Before / chase speed : 4 / He's chasing through the wall.
☆After / chase speed : 5 / It was modified not to penetrate the wall.

2. Revised to provide 5 "Dreamy marble" items at the start of a new chapter.

New Updates
1.60ver
1. At the entrance of the shrine, there were many situations where "carrier man" chased at a high speed and continued to overplay the game.
☆Before / Chasing speed : 6 / He's chasing the player. (Mid-out interval based on some foreign players)
☆After / Chasing speed : 4 / In addition to "Carrier Man," "thrill shaman" and "Yamanoke" chase together.

2. "Gangandara" Balance Adjustment
※The balance has been revised as some players are having difficulty meeting the normal ending and real ending conditions due to the pace of the wanderer "Gangandara."
☆Before / Chasing speed : 5 / Chapter 1 section "Small Box" event should be investigated, but due to speed, A lot of "dreamy marble" are spent avoiding pursuit.
☆After / Chasing speed : 4 / It's possible to avoid the chase enough using the dash function.
 Significantly reduced frequency of use of "dreamy marble".

3. "Shadow of disaster"Balance Adjustment
※No more walls by 1.45 version, but modified because it increases to 5 and consumes a lot of "dreamy marble" while avoiding pursuit.
☆Before / Chasing speed : 5 / It was modified not to penetrate the wall.
☆After / Chasing speed : 4 / Traditional "Shadow of disaster" have been set to stop chasing when using "dreamy marble", but have been modified to track to a reduced chase speed of 2: to suit the "Shaman type" wanderer, with the same effect of "cabinet" as other wanderers.

4. First Improvement of Convenience: Improvement of items paid at the beginning of Chapter 1 & Secret.
☆Before / "He got 10 dreamy marble, 5 chocolate bars and 1 camera battery. "Briefly describes how to use it after the text.
☆After / After the text "He got 10 dreamy marble, 5 chocolate bars and 1 camera battery. " , the image file containing the situation to be used during play and the description of the item was modified to display, and the item shortcut setting was changed the same as the original "Shadow corridor".
※"dreamy marble" No. 1 Convenient key "Chocolate bar" No. 2 Convenient key "Camera battery" No. 3 Convenient key

5. "Chocolate" and "Camera Battery" disappeared due to the new supply at the time of entry to the new chapter, but they were modified so that they would no longer disappear and would be kept in the event list after the next chapter.

6. Second improvement in convenience: improvements to missing persons rescue events.
※Chapter 3 At the beginning of the crossroads of choice, the missing persons listed on the "Missing Persons List" will appear in Chapter 1 to 3 and can be rescued using the "Black Match".
☆Before / Chapter 3, we witnessed missing persons while acquiring items needed for the conditions of the normal ending and real ending routes, but it was an ordinary event, so it was meaningless to rescue them.
☆After / During the acquisition of the items required for the Normal Ending/Real Ending Route, the body of the "missing person" event can be searched, a certain number of "dreamy marble", "chocolate bars" and "camera battery" have been modified to mention the missing person's name.

7. Secret Chapter "Black Killer" Balance Adjustment
※In the secret chapter, "Black Killer" chased right after the first encounter event and suddenly became a game over.
☆Before / Chase Speed : 5
☆ After / Chasing speed : 4

8. All Chapter New Wanderer "Butterfly of Blank" Added
※The new wanderer, "Butterfly of Blank" is a rover who helps the player, unlike "specter" "Cannibal centipede" "Butterfly of Blank" "dream owl" which appear in every chapter and damage the player.
"Butterfly of Blank" ?
Chasing speed: 3 It follows the player through the wall in a state, giving him the same effect as a "dreamy marble" when in contact with the player, and then disappears.
※Differences : "dreamy marble" neutralize all wanderers for 10 seconds other than "Shaman type", but in the case of "Butterfly of Blank", they neutralize all wanderers for 20 seconds other than "Shaman type".

9. Add Difficulty Selection
The difficulty level selection function has been added at the beginning of the prologue and secret chapters.
Difficulty levels include "easy," "normal," and "hell."


Update date : undecided
The current 1.60 version is fully updated, but while uploading the updated version to Steam, there was a bug that damaged the file name of the sound file and image file with the file name set to "Korean" and caused the game to not run properly.
The only solution is to change all file names to English, and at the same time, it takes a lot of time to change all settings used in Korean files to English names.

First of all, the Korean version will be updated first, and then we will update the English version that has been played a lot and finally the Japanese version.
